description: ...Darren brings a rare combination of thoughtful judgment, integrity, and a genuine commitment to solving real problems. He listens carefully, asks the right questions, and isn’t afraid to roll up his sleeves to get things done...he leads with principle and practicality. He cares deeply about people and understands that good policy should improve everyday lives... Utah would benefit from having someone with his character, work ethic, and steady leadership serving in the House....
title: Preston Cochrane - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
